html:
Claude Code Token Optimization Tool

Tokentrim is a free, local toolkit that helps extend Claude Code usage limits by optimizing tool output. It trims output, reads files in ranges, and spools long command output to disk, showing token spend per session in a dashboard.

What you get

Free version available, Pro lifetime license for $49, Pro monthly subscription for $9

Why tokentrim

Tokentrim is designed for developers and CTOs at 10-200 person US software companies who hit Claude Code limits. By using Tokentrim, companies can reduce their Claude Code costs and make their usage limits last longer.

FAQ

Is Tokentrim affiliated with Anthropic? No, Tokentrim is not affiliated with Anthropic.

What are the benefits of using Tokentrim? Tokentrim helps extend Claude Code usage limits, reduces costs, and provides a dashboard to track token spend per session.

Next step: Try Tokentrim for free today at https://suncal.github.io/tokentrim/
